meta.name: android-native-dev
meta.description: Android native application development and UI design guide. Use when building or fixing Android native apps, Kotlin / Jetpack Compose features, Gradle configuration, Material Design 3 UI, accessibility, build troubleshooting, or test coverage for Android projects. Prefer this skill whenever the task is specifically about Android native implementation rather than cross-platform mobile work.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 Android 原生开发指南回答，涵盖 Gradle 设置、Kotlin/Compose 代码、Material Design 3 UI、无障碍和构建测试等。
howto.when: 当你构建或修复 Android 原生应用，涉及 Kotlin、Compose、Gradle、Material Design 3、无障碍或构建问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 Gradle 包装器。
say.note: Claude 会指导初始化或修复 Gradle 环境。

say.text: 用 Jetpack Compose 写一个登录界面。
say.note: Claude 会给出遵循 M3 和最佳实践的代码。
Claude 会分析错误日志并给出修复建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude answers using Android native development guidelines, covering Gradle setup, Kotlin/Compose code, Material Design 3 UI, accessibility, and build/test troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're building or fixing an Android native app, involving Kotlin, Compose, Gradle, Material Design 3, accessibility, or build issues.

say_en.text: Help me configure the Gradle wrapper.
say_en.note: Claude guides initialization or repair of Gradle environment.

say_en.text: Write a login screen using Jetpack Compose.
say_en.note: Claude provides code following M3 and best practices.
Claude analyzes logs and suggests fixes.
